The **Gleaming Depths**, also known as the **Vulcan Research Laboratory** [1] a location in the Ash Heap region of Appalachia. They are situated northwest of Striker's Row and due south of the AMS Testing Site. [2] 

Originally a mine belonging to Atomic Mining Services, the location later known as the **Gleaming Depths** was used by the company to mine Coal. To mine the coal, the company utilized nuclear chargers. [3] As the coal began to run dry, the property was purchased from AMS by Raven Financial Holdings LLC, a front for the Enclave, with existing staff being relocated elsewhere. [4] [5] The purpose of the purchase was so the Enclave could initiate Project Vulcan, a project initiated by Thomas Eckhart intended to utilize and understand Ultracite, to further the Enclave's goals. [6] To this end, a laboratory was constructed and then sealed off from the surface world, to pursue their experimentation until the Enclave returns for the results. The facility was equipped with hydroponics equipment sourced from the Vault-Tec Corporation, which would allow the bunker to operate isolated from the surface world for decades. [7] To protect the facility, the EN06 Guardian was installed in the mine's upper level to keep out intruders, and members of Epsilon Squad were assigned to the facility. [8] [9] 

In the **Vulcan Research Laboratory**, project lead Dr. Robert Gaines and Dr. Esther Wright, among other scientists, began experimenting on the Ultracite, with differing opinions on how to approach the material. Dr. Wright insisted on experimentation using sonic waves to stimulate crystal growth, whereas Dr. Gaines believed radiation treatment to be the correct course of action. [10] Following the Great War, the facility lost contact with Raven Rock and The Whitespring Bunker, and Epsilon Squad began attempting to find routes through the mine tunnels back to the surface. [11] 

Utilizing sonic waves, Dr. Wright developed a process she referred to as "Ultragenesis", whereby the Ultracite crystals grew quickly and more untamed. [12] On July 31st, 2080 during experimentation, Dr. Gaines was killed when one of his test subjects broke free, turning him into "a human pretzel". While foul play was suspected, no investigation was carried out. [13] [14] Gaines' pet snake, Butch also escaped, getting loose in the facility. [15] On April 23rd, 2085, members of Epsilon squad first encountered Scorched on the surface, with Wasp and Python becoming infected with the Scorched Plague. On April 30th, the infected pair assaulted a superior officer and were killed by an automatic turret. [13] On June seventh, the rest of Epsilon squad showed symptoms of the plague and were quarantined. [13] 

As experimentation progressed, a side effect of the empowered ultracite made itself known. By July 24th, those exposed to it developed paranoia, delusions, and hysteria. [13] As the staff began killing each other, Epsilon Squad was called in to exterminate the scientists, but were still themselves afflicted with the scorched plague. [16] [17] On August 15th, martial law was declared, due to riots and evidence of Cannibalism. [13] On the 23rd of the month, Dr. Wright was apprehended, and held for tribunal as the cause of the lab's problems. The next day, she was found guilty of gross negligence and executed. [13] On August 30th, 2065, the bunker fully fell to the ultragenesis-induced madness. [13] 

In time, Butch the escaped snake would mutate due to exposure to the ultracite, becoming the Ultracite Terror. While the ultragenetic test subjects ran wild within the lower parts of the facility, Mole Miners would breach the upper mine and become altered by the ultragenetic crystals.

In 2105, the Vulcan Research Laboratory was opened to the surface, allowing Vault Dwellers from Vault 76 to enter and encounter the still scorched Epsilon Squad. [18]

Both outside and throughout the underground facility, several preparation areas can be found. Those areas can be used to prepare for raiding the location, and each area contains an Ammo Storage Box, Armor Workbench, Chemistry Station, Cooking Station, My Stash Box, Power Armor Station, Punch Card Machine, Scrapbox, Tinker's Workbench and Weapons Workbench.

The exterior consists of a fissure leading down toward the entrance, with several Hardened Mole Miners patrolling the surrounding area. Nearby, to the north, is a small camp that serves as initial preparation area.

Hardened Mole Miners patrolling around the fissure

Initial preparation area to the north

Entrance at the bottom of the fissure

After entering, a narrow tunnel leads into a small cave that serves as the first preparation area. From this cave, another narrow tunnel leads north to an opening, where a set of blue double doors, built inside a large red blast door, marks the entrance of the underground facility.

First preparation area

The facility entrance is a large, round room, in the center of which the EN06 Guardian rests, which can be activated by pushing a red button on the northern console. Sets of huge red blast doors, labeled A, B and C, are located on the southern, northwestern and northeastern sides, respectively. Concrete pillars are positioned around the center of the room, while stairs on the sides of the room lead to an elevated walkway that runs around the center of the room. A set of blue double doors, north of the console with the red button, is initially inaccessible, and only opens after defeating the Guardian.

Entrance room

B blast doors

C blast doors

Button that starts the encounter

After the blue double doors, a tunnel leads north, then west. At the end is the second preparation area, while a short segment to the north leads to the entrance door to the Drill Complex.

The main room has a large, inactive drill on the eastern side, with a red button that activates its fuel pump next to it. From this room, five double doors (two southwest, one northwest, one north and one to the northeast) are inaccessible until the aforementioned button is activated. They lead to the fuel storage, an interconnected system of tunnels, caves and a railroad track that runs from south to north.

The Gleaming Depths appear in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gleaming Depths* update.
